notes.title: Base Engine Update + Sequel News
notes.notes:
Currently live on the beta branch is an update that will help synchronise the different engine versions that are being used for different operating systems. This is an update primarily affecting WINDOWS USERS (as Mac/Linux users were already on this engine version). 

Ideally there should be very few visible changes, only some tiny bugfixes and an added word in one dialog line that was missing by accident. 

If you are a Windows user and have a bit of free time, we would like to invite you to switch over to the new engine testing branch, play a bit, and ensure that nothing weird happens (I've tested it myself but more eyes are better!) You can access the beta by right-clicking on the game in tyour library and selecting Properties, then Betas, then select the relevant one from the dropdown (renpy 6.99.12.2 - Testing engine upgrade June 2025) 

Official changelog:
[list]
[*] Engine update. This should increase compatiblity with newer machines; it may reduce compatibility with older machines, but machines it breaks are probably also too old to run Steam.,
[*] Minor save screen UI improvement.,
[*] Fixed a crash in the crash handler in some circumstances.,
[*] Fixed a crash saving game logs if you have non-ASCII characters in the path to the save directory on Windows.,
[*] Angle (alternate 3D acceleration) renderer selectable on Win32.,
[*] "who might had sympathy"→"who might have had sympathy" fixed.
[/list]

You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/251990/discussions/0/600780367643871274/]report any issues here[/url]!

notes.title: Adjusting Achievement Syncing
notes.notes:
We've put out a small update that almost no one should notice. Basically, one achievement (Unexpected Pairing - the commoner romance) was not syncing correctly between the steam account and the local copy, so if you'd unlocked it on Steam and then played the game on another computer, your in-game copy wouldn't show that achievement until you unlocked it on THAT machine.

This has now been corrected to work like the other achievements do.

Nothing else should be affected, but if you encounter any strange behavior please do let us know.

As for [i][b]Galaxy Princess Zorana[/b][/i], the game development is actually VERY advanced at this point, what's holding us back from launching a KS and starting beta tests is [b]trailer[/b] development rather than [b]game[/b] development. We've had a few pipeline issues getting a cool trailer made and we don't want to launch that without one. Hang in there, I promise the game is still proceeding as planned!

notes.title: The Larger Universe
notes.notes:
So here at last is the announcement we had hoped to provide earlier: the expansion of the Long Live The Queen universe! 

(Yes, I know some people are tired of franchises being called 'universes' but a) we couldn't call the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423154]group page[/url] just 'Long Live The Queen' because it would create a Steam naming conflict with the game, and b) since we're moving into the future in the stars, it truly [i]is[/i] expanding the game universe.)

The initial Steam page with in-development screenshots for the next game in this universe:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069630/Galaxy_Princess_Zorana

For detailed information and further updates, please clickthrough and wishlist/follow that title!

However I will cover a few basic questions about it here:

[h3]Is this definitely the same universe/setting?[/h3]

[b]Yes.[/b] Even though we're starting off in a different place and time, anyone who's played the first game will quickly see connections to the original setting, though it will take some exploration to find out more.  

[h3]Is this a direct sequel? Does my playthrough carry over?[/h3]

No. This game is far removed in space and time from the original story. Elodie is a distant historical figure only. 

[h3]Will I still die a lot?[/h3]

Probably! There are dozens of different characters who are capable of plotting your demise if you upset them and those assassinations can occur at any point, on top of all the story-related ways you can meet your doom.

[h3]Is there real-time 3d space combat?[/h3]

It's not that kind of game. It's still very much LLTQ, but with a bigger map to move around on and more characters to negotiate with. You will still be picking classes, changing outfits, and managing moods.

[h3]What features are new?[/h3]

Too much to cover but to mention a few things - skillcheck bubbles now give an indication of roughly how difficult any test was so that you have an idea of how much you'd need to train to pass it, you can hire advisors to provide certain skills for you if you don't have time to learn them, menu choices have a 'random' option if you can't make up your mind or just want to do a silly see-what-happens playthrough... Beyond that you should really go check out the new game page and ask in the discussions over there!

[h3]When will the game be out?[/h3]

Sorry, I don't have a launch date yet. It is still in development. I am hoping for a kickstarter [i]soon[/i] and the beta-test period to begin [i]soon after that[/i] and then we'll see. It's not quite playable end-to-end at this point but there's many hours of playable content already.

notes.title: Happy Anniversary, Long Live The Queen
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5276527/c16fe0bb68e4c1a29d8f8101caf93212817cdcfd.png[/img]
(Art by [url=https://twitter.com/acchanbd]acchanBD[/url])

This month is not just the Platinum Jubilee, it also marks ten years since the first full release of [i]Long Live The Queen[/i] (on the Hanako Games website - it didn't come to Steam until later). What a journey it's been! So many princesses murdered!

To celebrate, this week (Jun 13-20) we've set up our largest ever weekly Steam discount on LLTQ, so if any of your friends don't have the game yet, this is the best time to give them delicious gifts of chocolate. We've also commissioned a few pieces of bonus artwork, like the above, which should be dropping during the month.

So, what is coming in the future for LLTQ?

First, as some of you already know, a while back it was announced that Ratalaika Games would be porting the game to consoles. While I do not have a final release date yet, I currently expect that to happen sometime this year. Stay tuned (here, or on my twitter, or on their twitter) for more news as soon as it's available!

Second, yes, we are working on another game in the series. I can't show you pictures because right now everything is in a text-only phase, getting set up with dozens of skills, characters, quests, and events where unexpected talents might mean the difference between victory and defeat. (Using Wrestling to suplex a giant lizard? Using Contortion to hide inside a filing cabinet? Sure, why not!) 

The working title for now is [i]Long Live The Queen: Galaxy Princess Zorana[/i]. You are the pampered daughter of a mighty emperor (think Flash Gordon and Ming the Merciless) who unexpectedly comes to power when your father dies in a freak accident. Now you must work to win over your father's underlings and be proclaimed absolute ruler before someone else can take your Empire away from you.

Everything is still so early, it's hard to say much, but a few general plans:

* There will be some tie-ins to the first game, and you will probably get to mention how your Elodie turned out, but Elodie will not actually appear, as we're well into the future.
* You can still have a pet falcon! (But this time it will be made of metal.)
* It will be much easier to marry a female character and have heirs with her if you want. It's the future, we have the technology.
* It is likely that there will be a Kickstarter campaign eventually, but I need to do a LOT of internal development and testing first to ensure that this game design works before making it pretty enough to show anything public, so don't expect that this year. The game and story I have in mind is exciting but complicated and I want to be sure I'm bringing you the best.

Right now everything is subject to change! I'll bring you more news as soon as it's possible, but there's only one of me writing all these convoluted plotlines, so it does take a while. ːtxhappyː

notes.notes:
A childhood in the hands of Hanako Games can be filled with love and joy, but is always perilous. Hanako’s latest, A Little Lily Princess [official site], sends a spoiled girl to boarding school and maybe this time it’s fine. You can make friends and study and whatnot, and that sounds good, doesn’t it?

notes.title: 1.3 Plot Update Now Available + New Achievements
notes.notes:
The latest plot update for the game, complete with new story options, features, character portraits, marriages, and ways to completely ruin your country is now available.

There are also 6 new achievements to find, which will remove some people's 100% status but hopefully only temporarily.

If you want full spoiler-heavy details of everything that's been added, visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/251990/discussions/]discussion forums[/url] and read through the (long) beta thread. Otherwise, dive in and see what you can find!

And remember - the chicken had it coming.

notes.title: Long Live The Student Council President: Black Closet
notes.notes:
Being a child ruler is pretty tough, I should’ve known, but the number of ways everything can go horribly wrong in Long Live the Queen was a surprise and a delight. Developers Hanako Games are now working on a game about being student council president and surely that can’t be nearly as difficu- oh, no, it can. Black Closet [official site] will have players solving randomly-generated mysteries at a school, from cheating on tests to cases a bit more bloody. Come see the first trailer.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: 1.3 Plot Update Now in Beta
notes.notes:
A lot of new options and some new character portraits are being added to the game (currently in beta-testing). The beta version is available to all Steam users, and more information on opting-in plus a quick list of what's in store can be found in this discussion topic: http://steamcommunity.com/app/251990/discussions/0/620703493333077987/

If you have the time, please come have a look and report your thoughts and any problems you encounter.

There will be a new achievement added to the game but not until this patch leaves beta.

Hope you enjoy the new storylines!

notes.title: Have You Played Long Live The Queen?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game recommendations. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

Halfway between visual novel and ultra-specific RPG, Long Live The Queen is a surprisingly brutal matter of trying to stay alive when everyone – and everything – wants you dead, through no fault of your own. Unless you consider your own birth to be something you did deliberately.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Feature Update (Feb 8 2014)
notes.notes:
We've pushed out a small update which adds some new features and fixes a handful of typos. This is not a content update, no new plot has been added.

More details:

Skills screen clearly lists what skills are affected by current mood
Skip button appears on dialogue you've seen before (hide/show button toggled in preferences)
Failed study attempts (when your penalties meant you gained less than ten points and therefore got no skilltext) should now display a message explaining that you were too moody to learn properly
Version number visible on preferences screen
'Save Story' at an ending renamed to 'Show Log' 

Please let us know if you run into any problems.

notes.title: Wot I Think: Long Live The Queen
notes.notes:
Hanako Games’ sweetly brutal fantasy monarchy sim came out last Summer, and sadly I missed it at the time. Pray allow me to rectify that before ordering off with my head.

If the art style puts you off, how about this: Long Live The Queen is a Sansa Stark simulator.
